# sidecar.build_output_path { #healpyxel.sidecar.build_output_path }

```python
sidecar.build_output_path(input_path, mode, nside)
```

Build output path for sidecar file based on input and parameters.

Constructs a descriptive filename that encodes the processing parameters
for easy identification and downstream parsing.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                   | Default    |
|------------|--------|-----------------------------------------------|------------|
| input_path | Path   | Source input file path.                       | _required_ |
| mode       | str    | Assignment mode: ``'strict'`` or ``'fuzzy'``. | _required_ |
| nside      | int    | HEALPix nside parameter.                      | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                                                                                             |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | Path   | Output path in the same directory as input, with format::      <stem>.cell-healpix_assignment-<mode>_nside-<nside>_order-nested.parquet |
